## Summary

AJ Villalobos builds and maintains production Ruby on Rails applications for remote product teams. His experience spans fintech, healthtech, SaaS, aged care, childcare, property management, and Philippine small business software. Current work combines senior Rails engineering with AI-assisted development practices using Claude Code, custom skills, self-verifying agent loops, and parallel agents in git worktrees.
